dataTable.title: Data table

guidance.title: When to use / when not to use
guidance.use: Any admin list view backed by a paginated, filterable, sortable collection — the Identity & Access user/role/permission lists are the canonical example.
guidance.avoid: A tiny, fixed list with no need for search, sort, or paging — a plain list or the simpler Table primitive is lighter-weight there.

rows.columns: The column definitions — label, render function, sortability, alignment, responsive hiding.
rows.rows: The current page of data to render.
rows.rowKey: Derives a stable React key / identity string for a row.
rows.totalCount: Total row count across all pages — drives the footer summary and pager.
rows.state: The current page, page size, sort, search query and filters — usually from useDataTableState().
rows.onStateChange: Called with the next full state whenever the user sorts, searches, filters, or pages.
rows.isLoading: True while the very first page is loading — renders skeleton rows.
rows.isRefetching: True while a later page is loading with existing rows still shown — dims the body.
rows.isError: True when the last fetch failed — renders a retry row instead of data.
rows.errorMessage: User-facing error text shown alongside the retry action.
rows.onRetry: Called when the user clicks Retry in the error state.
rows.emptyState: Custom content shown when there are no rows and no filters are active.
rows.filteredEmptyState: Custom content shown when there are no rows but a search or filter is active.
rows.rowActions: Returns the row-level actions for a given row — up to 3 render inline, more overflow into a menu.
rows.toolbarStart: Extra content rendered at the start of the toolbar, before the search field.
rows.toolbarEnd: Extra content rendered at the end of the toolbar — typically a page-level Create button.
rows.filters: Filter definitions rendered in the toolbar, single- or multi-select.
rows.tableLabel: Accessible name for the table region — read by screen readers.
rows.onRowRemoved: Optional callback fired after DataTable itself notices a row disappeared.
rows.skeletonRowCount: Number of shimmer rows shown while loading — defaults to the current page size.
rows.rowLabel: Derives a human-readable label for a row, used in row actions' accessible names.

dataTable.mockError: Could not load this list. This is a simulated error for documentation purposes.

mobile.note: Real breakpoint detection uses useBreakpoint() — this section renders DataTableCards directly to preview the layout regardless of the current viewport width.

rules.toast: Toasts are polite, dismissible, and pause on hover/focus. A danger toast can never auto-dismiss — use an assertive Alert or a ConfirmDialog for anything that requires a decision.
rules.alert: Alert carries a Retry action and a correlation id for recoverable errors, and switches to role="alert" for validation summaries and danger banners.
rules.pageStates: EmptyState, FilteredEmpty, ErrorState, LoadingState, NotFound and AccessDenied share one panel surface — an empty list with no active filters always shows EmptyState, never FilteredEmpty.
rules.loadingBoundary: LoadingBoundary holds its fallback for at least 300ms after loading finishes, so a fast response never flashes a skeleton for a single frame.
rules.modal: Modal is labelled by its heading (aria-labelledby) and returns focus to its trigger on close. Irreversible actions require typing the exact, case-sensitive confirmation phrase.
rules.badgeStatus: Chips are neutral by default — colour is only applied with tone="semantic", where it maps to a documented state. Status always renders a dot and a label together, never colour alone.
